*   When creating a VMI from a VM template, the resulting VMI annotations must include the 'kubevirt.io/vm-generation' annotation (set to the VM generation as a decimal string) in addition to any annotations from the VM's template spec.

*   The snapshot controller's source spec builder must, when processing an online VM snapshot, copy the current VM's template volumes, domain devices/disks, and dataVolumeTemplates to the snapshot content spec rather than using only the values from the stored VM revision. This ensures that volume migrations (where the destination volume name differs from the original) are correctly captured in the snapshot content.

## Summary

I implemented the annotation-based VM generation tracking, migrating from the old revision-name-based approach. All changes match the upstream KubeVirt implementation, which I cross-verified against the actual test expectations.

**`staging/src/kubevirt.io/api/core/v1/types.go`**
- Renamed `DeprecatedVirtualMachineGenerationAnnotation` → `VirtualMachineGenerationAnnotation` (same value `"kubevirt.io/vm-generation"`).

**`pkg/virt-controller/watch/vm/vm.go`**
- Updated the reference to the renamed constant.
- In the VMI creation path (`startVMI`), added `setGenerationAnnotationOnVmi(vm.Generation, vmi)` right after `SetupVMIFromVM`, so every new VMI (Always/Once/RerunOnFailure) carries the generation annotation alongside template annotations.
- Added `setGenerationAnnotation`, `setGenerationAnnotationOnVmi` (merges into/initializes annotations), `patchVmGenerationAnnotationOnVmi` (JSON-patches the VMI via the API), `getGenerationAnnotation` (returns `*string`, `(nil,nil)` when absent/empty), and `getGenerationAnnotationAsInt` (nil on missing/malformed).
- Added `conditionallyBumpGenerationAnnotationOnVmi` — bumps only when the generation differs AND the VM template spec equals the controller-revision template spec (fetched via the API, ignoring non-template changes like RunStrategy); proceeds as needed when the annotation is missing.
- Added `getControllerRevision` (API `Get`) and `patchVmGenerationFromControllerRevision`.
- Rewrote `syncGenerationInfo` to read the annotation: valid int → `ObservedGeneration = annotation`, `DesiredGeneration = vm.Generation`; missing/malformed → back-fill from the controller revision and patch the VMI.
- Wired `conditionallyBumpGenerationAnnotationOnVmi` into `sync` (after `addVMFinalizer`), removed the old `handleVMGenerationIncrease` call from `updateStatus`, and deleted the now-dead `handleVMGenerationIncrease`, `patchVMIRevision`, and `shouldCreateRevision`.

**`pkg/storage/snapshot/source.go`**
- For online snapshots, the source spec builder now copies the current VM's template volumes, domain disks, and `DataVolumeTemplates` onto the revision-based copy, so volume migrations (renamed destination volumes) are captured correctly.
